title: Grateful Dead Live at Fillmore East (Late Show) on 1970-01-02

ai_review.summary: Soundboard recording with noticeable cuts and speed issues, but the show shines thanks to a scorching Mason's Children, stellar Cosmic Charlie and an epic late‑night Dark Star.
ai_review.review: The performance is widely praised – early material like Mason’s Children, Casey Jones, Black Peter and Cosmic Charlie are described as “tasty” and “all‑time classics,” while the late show delivers a monumental Dark Star that showcases Jerry’s wild improvisation. The SBD source suffers from nasty cuts, channel swaps and pitch‑waver problems that require balancing and correction, making the audio quality only fair despite its completeness.

ai_rating.rationale: Three detailed reviews (average 4–5 stars) praise the musical performance strongly, while multiple reviewers note consistent recording flaws that keep the overall rating from being higher.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Several nasty cuts and missing sections; frequent speed/pitch wavers needing +/‑1% corrections; channel swaps on many tracks; overall balance/volume issues, but the source is complete enough for listening.

show_quality.setlist_flow: The early show flows tightly with strong, soulful renditions and a celebrated Cosmic Charlie segue; the late show veers into experimental territory, culminating in an extended Dark Star that, despite occasional tape‑speed glitches, captures the band’s transitional ‘70 energy.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Praised for ripping loose on Dark Star and adding extra punch on several numbers.
band_member_comments.Keys: Tom Constanten highlighted for organ work (especially on Dark Star and High Time); Pigpen’s organ presence noted in the Dark Star mix.
band_member_comments.Drums: Mickey Hart’s percussion singled out as creative on Casey Jones and prominent throughout the Dark Star; drumming described as “tumbling” and “dynamic.”
